svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
LANDING GEAR: BAYS + 3.0 IN R6 LEGS
O4 mm pins with clips, 5 per leg
Seat each bay in its sponson rebate; port and starboard bays are not interchangeable.
Fasten each bay with its 4 x M3.
Build each leg: CF cheeks, springs, fuses, sleeve, cage, pins (DRAFT, not bench-verified).
Pin each leg into its bay; fit the safety cord as secondary retention.
Check all four feet touch a flat plate together.
The gear is not flight-cleared. Do not fly until the gear analysis closes (docs/LANDING_GEAR_ANALYSIS.md).
